results.issue: The full name of the HCD Plan and the fact that the proposal 'no longer' follows the policies are not stated on page 8.
results.suggestion: Because the proposal does not meet Policies 7.6.4. and 7.6.5 of the Parkdale HCD Plan, it needs a new Section 42 approval under the Ontario Heritage Act.

results.issue: The sentence omits that the recommended approval is subject to conditions.
results.suggestion: City staff recommend that City Council approve the demolition of the non-contributing building and the construction of a new 16-storey mixed-use building at 1337 Queen Street West, subject to conditions.

results.issue: The sentence states the condition as part of an active approval rather than a recommended condition, and omits 'and elevations'.
results.suggestion: A recommended condition is that the replacement building for 1337 Queen Street West be built substantially according to the plans and elevations by LGA Architectural Partners dated September 25, 2026.
